main_body: roofed stone well covered in snow
top_band: snow-covered roof band at rows 1-8, plus stone well rim/opening at rows 16-23
evidence: The well shows a clear 3/4 view with a snow-covered roof band (rows 1-8) overhanging the wooden supports, an elliptical well rim/opening (rows 16-23) with 6 rows of dark interior water/void visible between the back and front rims, and a stone brick front face below (rows 24-30).

style.evidence: Compared to the reference well (prop-well-roofed), the candidate is much simpler and flatter: the stone base is a flat rectangular wall with repetitive uniform 2-colour brick lines instead of individually shaded stones curving around a cylinder; the bucket is a flat 2-colour rectangle with no rim or shading; the wooden posts are simple vertical strips.
